title: Always unpairs, can’t add agents on mob, annoying agent categories
body: First off I can never use this because every time I open the app it’s unpaired, which of course is impossible to repair without being home. Second you get a blank workspace with no agents. You can only add agents from the desktop. Third they have these silly agent types like “product manager”, “backend developer” etc that are totally unnecessary. Let me use Claude code. Let me branch. Let me start clean sessions remotely. Fourth the text display and entry is a disaster. Unreadable and unparsed responses on a mobile app. Can’t respond to user input questions from CC. Just unusable. 3 stars for potential. No stars for actually working.

title: Crazy good.
body: Arguably top tier in my opinion.

title: Exactly what I was looking for
body: Being able to consolidate all of my subscriptions into one tool, and then run projects and agents on specific models by default has dramatically increased my ability to stay on top of my projects and not feel lost all the time as to where a chat had happened or if I finished a project or thread. Also great to have the personal assistant who can work across all projects and help coordinate global changes.

title: This is the best dev platform by a kilometer
body: These guys are tireless. At least one release a week, always with solid bug fixes and new features. There is no other unified platform that comes close, and comparable operational efficiency requires not just multiple applications, but some jankiness that gets tiresome. I never had a big desire to move to Paris, but if this application represents a scene….
